description: 福岡県 指定福祉避難所一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福岡県. 福岡県内の指定福祉避難所の一覧です。 ※福岡県官民データ連携基盤に指定福祉避難所の情報を連携するために、指定緊急避難場所のタグ付けが必要であるため、指定緊急避難場所のタグ付けをしていますが、掲載しているデータは指定福祉避難所のデータになります。. Coverage: 福岡県. The portal files it under the publisher 福岡県. Its tags are 指定緊急避難場所, 福祉, 自治体標準ODS, 避難所. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
